parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json.body;const required=['posts','brand_name'];const missing=required.filter(f=>!body[f]);if(missing.length)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'Missing: '+missing.join(', ')}}];const posts=Array.isArray(body.posts)?body.posts:[];if(posts.length===0)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'posts must be a non-empty array'}}];const platforms=['twitter','linkedin','instagram','facebook','tiktok','reddit','youtube','other'];const categories=['positive','negative','question','complaint','feature_request','mention','crisis','neutral'];const formattedPosts=posts.slice(0,20).map((p,i)=>({postId:p.post_id||('POST-'+String(i+1).padStart(3,'0')),platform:platforms.includes(p.platform)?p.platform:'other',authorHandle:p.author_handle||'',authorName:p.author_name||'',postContent:(p.post_content||'').trim().slice(0,500),postCategory:categories.includes(p.category)?p.category:'neutral',followerCount:parseInt(p.follower_count)||null,verified:p.verified===true||p.verified==='true',requiresUrgentResponse:p.urgent===true||p.urgent==='true',context:(p.context||'').slice(0,200)}));return[{json:{valid:true,brandName:body.brand_name.trim(),brandDescription:(body.brand_description||'').slice(0,300),brandVoice:(body.brand_voice||'professional and friendly').slice(0,200),posts:formattedPosts,escalationEmail:body.escalation_email||'',doNotMention:Array.isArray(body.do_not_mention)?body.do_not_mention:(body.do_not_mention||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean),currentPromotion:(body.current_promotion||'').slice(0,200),replyEmail:body.reply_email||null}}];

values.content: You write social media replies for brands. Good social media replies: match the platform's tone (Twitter is punchy; LinkedIn is professional; Instagram is warm); acknowledge the specific thing the person said (not generic); are human and not corporate-speak; de-escalate complaints without making promises the brand can't keep; handle crises carefully by avoiding admission of fault until facts are clear. Always respond in valid JSON only.
